title: egg-hsi-fertility: spatial-spectral deep learning for pre-incubation egg fertility screening
description: Code for a leakage-controlled evaluation of spatial-spectral deep learning (YOLO11 and other backbones with matched non-spatial controls) for pre-incubation chicken egg fertility screening from transmission hyperspectral images, using the public dataset of Ahmed et al. (Illinois Data Bank, doi:10.13012/B2IDB-8141497_V1).
